changes: One package now works with or without Sidechain Compressor: a muted track that another module listens to, such as a side-chain KEY, keeps feeding it.
MUTE MODE now survives a power cycle when installed over USB on a Modwerk base.
Needs a newer beta base; the site asks for a base update first.
Known issue: until Sidechain Compressor supports this, a muted Sidechain KEY track goes silent in the soft mute modes.
Known issue: not yet tested on hardware, including sound and power-cycle behaviour.
Over USB on a newer Modwerk base, Mute Modes can now be installed together with POLY8.
Needs a newer beta base; older bases refuse this package, and Undo keeps 0.1.0 for them.
Known issue: not yet tested on hardware.
Adds OT, OTFX, OTFX-T and DT-T mute behaviours under PROJECT > SYSTEM > PERSONALIZE, keeping the MKII LED BRIGHTNESS row.
Picks a matching variant automatically beside Sidechain Compressor, so a muted KEY track keeps feeding the compressor.
Known issue: not yet tested on hardware.
Media only: new artwork showing the four mute behaviours.
